area: navigation, history, reload and unknown addresses
situation: Start at the board address #/ with the default data and let the clock run 2200 ms, so that every column has loaded.
Enter the address #/card/SL-102 in the address bar while the app runs. Let the clock run 300 ms. Press Escape.
question: What is the address, how did the history change, and which part has focus?
answer: The board at #/. Escape added a new entry (two more than at the start), because the card was not opened from the board. Focus is on card SL-102.
